science.title: The fly's brain
science.body:
This fly's reaction uses a neural model built from connections observed in the brain of a male fruit fly (MaleCNS v1.0). It is a simplified simulation: a selected circuit of 816 neurons and 38,521 connections around the visual escape pathways, with parameters chosen by us. The game world provides the stimuli it reacts to - approaching objects and the edges. It does not receive the finger position, the chosen tool or the fury.

It is not a whole brain, not a living animal, it feels no pain and does not learn between rounds. The data authors do not sponsor or endorse this game.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
This version has no accounts, ads, purchases or third-party analytics. Preferences and records stay on this device only. When the game opens it downloads the neural package from our hosting; that request appears in the server's technical logs like any web page visit. Nothing else is sent.

Tap near the fly.
